findings.summary: The current public SpeedRunner ScienceWorld replay/no-replay configs are more tightly matched on task 3 than their task_id fields suggest: both use the same GPT-5.4-mini rollout/sleep settings and 200/30/50 rollout-test schedule, and current seed-42 list-family data construction applies the same RNG operations to family 3 before family 4 exists in the [3,4] arm. Under the same ScienceWorld environment enumeration, the selected 200 train and 30 test records for task 3 are therefore identical by construction.

The current SpeedRunner evaluator separates list-task metrics by task_family_id. With train_size=200, task 3 is evaluated independently at rollout counts 50/100/150 and again at the 200 boundary, so the extra task-4 family in the no-replay config need not dilute the task-3 metric under the current harness. This is current-code evaluation isolation, not proof of the historical Figure-12 raw run identity.

Stronger current-arm data/evaluation matching does not close the core causal-provenance gap: allow_replay changes the ASI induction system prompt and available tool contract, requiring scripted test trajectories during proposal generation, and then changes commit/revert admission. Current implementation therefore remains a verification-enabled-vs-no-replay variant comparison rather than a same-candidate-bytes admission-only intervention.

MemCompiler's initial public source already included the ScienceWorld harness and test JSONL, but its persistent memory lives at an external output path and the same root revision ignores *.db, output*/, .db*/, logs and zip artifacts. Thus source revision can bind harness/data but cannot recover the evaluated Table-3 memory-bank bytes; a separate archived memory/run manifest is required.

protocol_change_rationale: No new validator was added. Existing evaluated-run source binding, replay-export derivation/coverage, transactional admission provenance, and fixed-selected receiver-effect gates already reject the remaining historical-run and proposal-identity gaps. This run narrows two confounds and strengthens the required provenance search target instead of adding redundant protocol surface.

scope_guard.speedrunner_current_configs: Task-3 subset and evaluator isolation are exact current-code derivations conditional on the same ScienceWorld environment enumeration. They do not prove the paper-time run used this source revision or preserve candidate bytes across replay/no-replay arms.
scope_guard.speedrunner_figure12: Do not estimate raw Figure-12 values from the plot. Do not promote paper-level 'all other components unchanged' language to implementation-verified proposal-frozen admission causality without historical candidate/replay/admit artifacts and run/source binding.
scope_guard.memcompiler_initial_source: Initial-source harness presence is not evaluated-memory-state identity. Current-code UPDATE_MEMORY or model defaults must not be retroactively attributed to Table 3 without a run manifest.

The strongest desired science-domain intervention — fixed bank + same selected persistent record + same state/guidance + receiver effect only — remains unresolved.
